_comment: AC4 corpus for tests/test_case_fold_sweep.py. Each row is run through the real no_human.agent.guard.evaluate() entry point (Bash, forbidden_paths=[], never_push_to=['main']). Several rows here (the capitalised GH/RM/FIND/GIT spellings) are denied only via matchers in guard.py that key off exec_names.host_folds_case()/case_flags() with NO cwd/path_env override -- their correct denied-ness is a property of the HOST this suite runs on (a folding host's shell will actually resolve `RM` to `rm` via the filesystem; a non-folding host's shell gets 'command not found' and there is nothing to deny), not a universal constant. `baseline_folding` records denied-ness (true=denied, false=allowed) measured on a case-folding host (macOS/APFS, where this corpus was originally captured by restoring exec_names.py/venv_install_guard.py to their parent-commit content via `git show HEAD:<path>` -- this dev sandbox's destructive-op guard blocks `git worktree add` -- into a scratch copy of src/no_human and re-running the same corpus against it with sys.path pointed there instead; on this single-volume dev host that measurement coincides with post-fix for every row). `baseline_nonfolding` records the same rows' denied-ness on a genuinely case-sensitive host (Linux/ext4, e.g. CI), derived from the current (post-fix) code's own documented fold-dependent matchers rather than assumed -- see test_no_corpus_row_moved_from_denied_to_allowed, which measures this run's real host class and selects the matching baseline before comparing, so a case-sensitive CI runner is compared against the answers a case-sensitive host is actually supposed to produce instead of a macOS-only measurement. This file's job is the AC4 safety net (zero DENY->ALLOW, relative to the row's own host class) rather than the closing-direction proof; the closing-direction proof (PIP/Pip/PIP3/UV installer rows flipping ALLOW->DENY) lives in test_the_sweep_moved_rows_in_the_closing_direction, which needs a constructed two-venv session to exercise structurally and is therefore not representable as static cwd/env literals here.
